widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

See a whole folder at a glance: every picture in one sheet, with its name under it. Great for picking the best of a shoot, sending a client an overview, or checking what a big folder holds before you process it.

 Pick your folder

  1. On Load Images from Folder Pixaroma, click Browse and pick your folder, or paste the folder's path into the box.
  2. Click Pick images, then Select all, or click only the pictures you want. The button shows how many are picked.
  3. Press Run once. Leave the Run count at 1: the node sends every picture through by itself, one after the other.

This workflow opens with no folder picked: choose your own folder, or try it first on the demo folder Old Pictures inside the Media Inputs folder that comes with these workflows.

 A folder inside ComfyUI's own input or output folder works straight away. A folder anywhere else works too, but pick it once with Browse: that is how ComfyUI knows you allowed it.

 Pictures go through in name order. Name them 01_, 02_ and so on if the order matters.

 Change the look

  • Type a title, or leave it empty for no title.
  • columns: 0 = automatic. Type 4 to always get 4 pictures per row.
  • cell_size: 384 is good for up to about 40 pictures. Smaller for big folders: the sheet is never bigger than 8192 pixels on its long side.
  • show_names off for a clean sheet with pictures only.

 Image Grid works after ANY folder workflow: wire the results into images and the originals into before for a before and after sheet (folder 8, workflow 1).

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Folder not approved Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video 

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"How to Use","icon":"to-do","color":"#2a9d8f"}}

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Images from Folder Pixaroma (1. your folder) - Point it at any folder of pictures and pick them. Press Run once and every picture goes to the grid. Its resize is Off: the grid makes them small itself.
  • Image Grid Pixaroma (2. the layout) - Lays every picture out in one grid with its file name under it. columns 0 picks a near-square grid by itself, cell_size is the size of each picture, gap the space between them, background white, dark, black or grey, and title a line across the top.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (the contact sheet) - Saves the sheet as a JPG into ComfyUI/output/Contact Sheets, numbered, so a new Run never replaces the last one.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Nodes Info","icon":"node-v5","color":"#3d7cc9"}}

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

WhatTime
6 picturesunder 1 s
100 picturesa few seconds

No AI model runs here, so any computer is fast at it.

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (about 18 GB for Klein and its text encoder), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Run Times","icon":"run-timer","color":"#3f9a4f"}}
